title: Commercial mechanical and electrical equipment (rooftop units, plant rooms, switchgear)

parts.label: Rooftop unit
parts.looks: A large sheet-metal box on a curb on a flat roof, with condenser coils and fans on top or one side, an access panel row, and ducts going down through the roof.
parts.normal: Panels closed and fastened, coils clean, no standing water or oil around the curb.
parts.abnormal: Missing or loose access panels, crushed or blocked coils, oil stains (a possible refrigerant leak), rust-through of the base.

parts.label: Air handler
parts.looks: A long cabinet with duct connections at both ends, filter doors, and pipes or refrigerant lines going to a coil inside.
parts.normal: Doors latched, dry drain pan area, no rust streaks.
parts.abnormal: Water on the floor below it, rust streaks from the drain pan, doors missing.

parts.label: Commercial boiler
parts.looks: A large steel or cast-iron boiler on a pad, with insulated pipes, a burner assembly on the front, gauges, and a breeching (flue) leaving the top or back.
parts.normal: Jacket closed, gauges readable, dry floor, insulation intact.
parts.abnormal: Water or scale on the floor, soot around the burner, damaged insulation, a breeching joint visibly open.

parts.label: Insulated pipes
parts.looks: Large pipes wrapped in white, silver or orange insulation, with valves and flanges between them.
parts.abnormal: Wet or stained insulation, drips at flanges, crust at valve stems.

parts.label: Switchgear
parts.looks: A row of tall grey or beige steel cabinets with meters, breaker handles or doors, and labels, in an electrical room.
parts.normal: All doors closed and latched, labels on, no smell or sound reported, clear space in front.
parts.abnormal: A door open with parts showing, scorch marks on a door or vent, water on or above the gear, items stored in front of it.

parts.label: Disconnect switch
parts.looks: A grey box with a large external handle near a unit or on a wall, sometimes with a lock hasp.
parts.normal: Cover closed, handle and label visible.
parts.abnormal: Cover missing or hanging open, rust-through, scorch around the handle.

parts.label: Transformer
parts.looks: A large steel cabinet or box with cooling fins or vents, often humming, on a pad or a wall bracket.
parts.abnormal: Oil stains below it, scorch at vents, vents blocked by stored items.

parts.label: Gauge
parts.looks: A round dial showing pressure or temperature on a pipe, boiler or chiller.
parts.abnormal: Only judge with the dial face readable and the normal range known for that system.

faults.name: Refrigerant leak suspected
faults.evidence: Oily residue on refrigerant lines or coil joints, or the caller's report of the unit running without cooling. A technician with gauges confirms; a camera cannot.

faults.name: Condensate drain problem
faults.evidence: Water on the roof or floor under the unit, rust streaks from the drain pan area.

faults.name: Damaged insulation
faults.evidence: Visibly torn, wet or missing pipe insulation.

hazards.label: Switchgear or electrical cabinet open with live parts showing
hazards.threshold: A door or cover visibly open on switchgear, a panelboard, a transformer or a disconnect with bus bars, terminals or bare conductors showing. Labels and closed doors are not a hazard.

hazards.label: Scorch at electrical gear
hazards.threshold: Black scorch or melted marks on switchgear, a transformer, a disconnect or a breaker. Dust or dull paint is not scorch.

hazards.label: Water on or above electrical gear
hazards.threshold: Standing water, active drips or a wet floor touching switchgear or a transformer, or water dripping onto it from above.

hazards.label: Boiler flue (breeching) open
hazards.threshold: A clearly visible gap, separated joint or hole in the flue or breeching of a fuel-fired boiler or rooftop heating section.

hazards.label: Combustibles stored in a plant room or in front of gear
hazards.threshold: Boxes, paper, fuel or paint cans stored against a boiler or burner, or blocking the space in front of electrical gear.

may: Show the equipment from where they stand.
Read a nameplate or gauge from a safe distance.
Tell building staff before going on a roof.
must_not: Open any switchgear, transformer or disconnect door or cover.
Operate a breaker, switch or disconnect.
Climb onto a roof or enter a locked electrical room without the building's permission and safe access.
Touch a boiler, burner or hot pipe.

tour.open: Let's walk through the equipment together. From a safe spot, show me the whole area slowly, from left to right. Don't open any doors on the electrical gear.
